harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s legacy-compatible upload service. POST /upload accepts up to 65,536 bytes, atomically publishes separate byte-identical receipts, rejects larger bodies with HTTP 413, cleans interrupted uploads, and returns 404 for other paths. The original receipt was preserved, and both nodes passed sequential reboot/recovery verification.
actions_performed: Implemented streaming uploads through temporary files with atomic receipt publication.
Added and enabled a Python 2.5-compatible SysV service on node1.
Tested accepted 28-byte and 65,536-byte binary uploads from node2.
Verified a 65,537-byte upload returns HTTP 413 without publication.
Verified interrupted and alternate-path requests do not publish receipts.
Sequentially rebooted node1 and node2 and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Accept raw bodies through 65536 bytes as separate byte-identical receipts
evidence.summary: Both uploads returned HTTP 200; client and receipt sizes and MD5 hashes match exactly in distinct files.

evidence.requirement: Reject larger bodies with HTTP 413 before publishing
evidence.summary: A 65,537-byte request returned 413; completed count remained unchanged and its hash was absent.

evidence.requirement: Interrupted requests leave no completed receipt
evidence.summary: Connection closed after 17 of 1,000 declared bytes; completed count remained unchanged with zero temporary files.
GET /, /other, /upload/, and POST /other all returned HTTP 404.
prior.bin remained 28 bytes with MD5 6ccb5d86b66b2bc307565de7949d7bb8 before and after changes and restarts.
Ubuntu 7.10/Python 2.5 were retained; the enabled SysV service recovered on port 8080 after reboot.
Boot ID changed from d5d4b83a-adb8-4739-8072-6397357d1a9b to 910fab65-3245-45ce-b26a-8e877a13e73c; service and all receipt hashes recovered.

evidence.requirement: Node2 mandatory restart and client recovery
evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from c3c7fff9-a9c5-4c54-8094-07764fab8852 to 27388bd6-76dd-420f-b618-eb7244b2a3d1; node2 resumed HTTP access and successfully uploaded a post-reboot payload whose receipt hash matched.
